diagnosis: The repaired parent passes the necessary training nonregression screen on union and joint-leader-removal but not common-five wealth. It has no ordinary reassignment of an intact full book. A non-mutating observer reproduces every parent target exactly and finds currently eligible, materially stronger unheld names blocked by full capacity:116/39/94 dates in the three core pools, including9/3/8 existing scheduled-review nodes. These are causal opportunity nodes, not profitable counterfactuals. The common-five dollar PnL difference in one optical leader is not a stock-specific design rule.
rule: At an existing scheduled review (session modulo Config.rebalance, currently10, equals zero), and only within the parent's allocation path when no actual protective obligation is pending and current risk cap is one, inspect an actually full two-position book. The weakest currently held score must rank below current position capacity among ready, finite-score securities, and that holding must have been actually held for at least Config.rebalance sessions. The strongest currently eligible unheld score must be strictly positive and exceed1.25 times the weaker score (a nonpositive weaker score is compared with zero). The25% margin is the existing quant leadership hysteresis, not a new searched grid. If these conditions hold, request full sale of only that weakest holding, latch its actual-zero exit obligation, and suppress every new increase on that close. Otherwise retain the original parent allocation exactly.
funding: The challenger is an observed reason to free a slot, not a guaranteed fill or a reserved right to buy. No hypothetical sale proceeds or replacement units are allocated on the sale close. A blocked or partial sale remains pending and blocks purchases until actual zero inventory. Only a later close with observed cash and actual vacancy can apply the unchanged current eligibility, risk, cash and concentration rules. Reassess the challenger then; it may no longer qualify, in which case keep cash. Do not reset risk history or readmission to make a replacement feasible.
independence: Reuse only independently written quant ownership and intent code. No trades strategy source, date keys, stock keys, sector-specific thresholds, forecast retraining or rule search is added.
selection: Exactly one fixed candidate, not a new rotation parameter grid. Use the unchanged pre-2026 selector, three core scopes, incumbent wealth/drawdown/fill deficit and objective. Preserve every result and failed predecessor. The archived parent remains separately identified and is not relabeled as this source.
evaluation: Unchanged full, bull, late-June-through-August, July-August and retrospective-2026 windows. Original native references, removals/subsets/cost/delay/prefix and joint economic requirements remain mandatory. Do not combine separate policy winners or promote training-only improvements.

limitations: A stronger causal score does not establish higher future return. An opportunity sale can leave cash if prices, eligibility or funding change. Already inspected2026 is retrospective.
